description: Fundación de datos y contrato compartido: migración DB (bucket privado payment-evidence + policies storage.objects + tabla payment_photo_evidence 1:N + FKs compuestas + uq_payments_id_org + trigger de límite máx 3 + RLS + seed del flag payment_photo_evidence) y el contrato @fundo360/shared (interfaz, constantes, Zod, tests). Es la base que importan FEAT-002 (mobile) y FEAT-003 (web); va PRIMERO. Independiente de FEAT-002/003 salvo que ambas dependen de esta.
steps: Crear supabase/migrations/20261006000001_create_payment_photo_evidence.sql replicando el precedente supabase/migrations/20261002000001_create_picking_photo_evidence.sql (bucket+policies+seed del flag) y el patrón 1:N de supabase/migrations/20261005000002_create_dispatch_receipts.sql (tabla aparte + FKs compuestas de tenant). Orden del archivo: (a) INSERT INTO storage.buckets id/name 'payment-evidence', public=false, file_size_limit=10485760, allowed_mime_types ARRAY['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp'], ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING.

(b) Policies sobre storage.objects acotadas al bucket: CREATE POLICY "org_read_payment_evidence" FOR SELECT USING (bucket_id='payment-evidence' AND (is_platform_admin() OR (storage.foldername(name))[1]=current_org_id()::text)); CREATE POLICY "org_insert_payment_evidence" FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (bucket_id='payment-evidence' AND (is_platform_admin() OR ((is_admin() OR is_supervisor() OR is_crew_lead()) AND (storage.foldername(name))[1]=current_org_id()::text))). SIN UPDATE/DELETE (evidencia inmutable).

(c) ALTER TABLE payments ADD CONSTRAINT uq_payments_id_org UNIQUE (id, organization_id); -- payments NO lo tiene hoy (verificado en 20260829000005_tenant_composite_fks.sql); requisito de la FK compuesta.

(d) CREATE TABLE payment_photo_evidence (id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), organization_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, payment_id UUID NOT NULL, image_path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(image_path)>0), uploaded_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_payment_photo_evidence_id_org UNIQUE (id, organization_id)). SIN updated_at (inmutable, sin trigger update_updated_at_column).

(e) FKs compuestas: ALTER TABLE payment_photo_evidence ADD CONSTRAINT fk_pay_evidence_payment_org FOREIGN KEY (payment_id, organization_id) REFERENCES payments (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE; y fk_pay_evidence_uploaded_by_org FOREIGN KEY (uploaded_by, organization_id) REFERENCES workers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT.

(f) Índices: CREATE INDEX idx_payment_photo_evidence_organization ON payment_photo_evidence (organization_id); CREATE INDEX idx_payment_photo_evidence_payment_id ON payment_photo_evidence (payment_id).
(g) Trigger de tenant: CREATE TRIGGER trg_set_org_id_payment_photo_evidence BEFORE INSERT ON payment_photo_evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_organization_id().

(h) Límite máx 3: CREATE FUNCTION enforce_payment_evidence_limit() que hace SELECT count(*) INTO n FROM payment_photo_evidence WHERE payment_id = NEW.payment_id; IF n>=3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_LIMIT: ...' USING ERRCODE='check_violation'; END IF; RETURN NEW; y CREATE TRIGGER trg_enforce_payment_evidence_limit BEFORE INSERT ... FOR EACH ROW.

(i) RLS: ALTER TABLE payment_photo_evidence ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "admin_all_payment_evidence" FOR ALL USING (is_platform_admin() OR (is_admin() AND organization_id=current_org_id())); CREATE POLICY "writer_insert_payment_evidence" FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (is_platform_admin() OR ((is_admin() OR is_supervisor() OR is_crew_lead()) AND organization_id=current_org_id() AND uploaded_by=current_worker_id())); CREATE POLICY "member_read_payment_evidence" FOR SELECT USING (is_platform_admin() OR ((is_admin() OR is_supervisor() OR is_crew_lead()) AND organization_id=current_org_id())).

(j) Seed del flag: INSERT INTO platform_feature_flags (key, name, description, category, strategy, enabled) VALUES ('payment_photo_evidence','Foto de respaldo en pagos','Permite adjuntar hasta 3 imágenes de respaldo al registrar un pago (p. ej. pago en mano/efectivo). Las imágenes se guardan en almacenamiento privado por organización y se acceden con enlace firmado temporal. No afecta el monto ni la liquidación.','pagos','org_override',false) ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING.

(k) Header comentado con la reversibilidad (DROP TABLE ... CASCADE; DROP FUNCTION enforce_payment_evidence_limit; DROP POLICY org_read/org_insert ON storage.objects; DELETE FROM storage.buckets WHERE id='payment-evidence'; DELETE FROM platform_feature_flags WHERE key='payment_photo_evidence'; ALTER TABLE payments DROP CONSTRAINT uq_payments_id_org) y COMMENT ON TABLE/COLUMN explicando inmutabilidad. NO tocar settlements ni prevent_paid_settlement_update; la evidencia no altera monto ni liquidación.

En packages/shared/src/types/index.ts añadir la interfaz PaymentPhotoEvidence { id: string; organization_id: string; payment_id: string; image_path: string; uploaded_by: string; created_at: string; }.

En packages/shared/src/constants/index.ts añadir ERROR_CODES.PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_LIMIT='PAYMENT_EVIDENCE_LIMIT'; FEATURE_FLAGS.PAYMENT_PHOTO_EVIDENCE='payment_photo_evidence'; y export const PAYMENT_EVIDENCE = { MAX_IMAGES: 3, BUCKET: 'payment-evidence' } as const.
En packages/shared/src/validation/index.ts añadir export const createPaymentEvidenceSchema = z.object({ payment_id: z.string().uuid(), image_path: z.string().min(1, 'Ruta de imagen requerida') }).

Crear packages/shared/src/types/payment-evidence.test.ts (patrón packages/shared/src/types/dispatch.test.ts) con: PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.MAX_IMAGES===3; PAYMENT_EVIDENCE.BUCKET==='payment-evidence'; FEATURE_FLAGS.PAYMENT_PHOTO_EVIDENCE==='payment_photo_evidence'; resolveFeatureFlag(undefined,undefined)===false; createPaymentEvidenceSchema acepta payload válido y rechaza payment_id no-uuid e image_path vacío.

Actualizar la tabla 'Catálogo de flags vigentes' en .kiro/steering/feature-flags.md añadiendo la fila: payment_photo_evidence | Foto de respaldo en pagos | pagos | org_override | Hasta 3 imágenes de respaldo al registrar un pago (Storage privado por tenant).
